label: Heading
summary: The screen record's field, or fixed text, as a title.

label: List
summary: Records of a collection, with optional weekly progress.

label: Form
summary: Adds a record, or edits the screen's record if it has one.

label: Button
summary: Runs an action or a sequence of actions.

label: Button group
summary: Multiple buttons arranged side by side or stacked, each with its own actions.

label: Chart
summary: Record counts or sums per day, week or month.

label: Calendar
summary: A month view marking dates with records.

label: Totals
summary: Record counts or sums, optionally by category and current week or month.

label: Plot
summary: Compare numeric series as line, grouped bar or area charts.

label: Text
summary: Readable body text or a record field, preserving paragraphs without HTML.

example.text: Add a record to get started.

label: Table
summary: Searchable collection columns with field labels, formatting and optional record navigation.

label: Search and select
summary: Live autocomplete from a declared source; copies selected result fields into saved records.

label: Refresh saved items
summary: Refreshes a scoped source for each saved record using field-to-parameter bindings, with progress and honest errors.
